mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in the past three months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 3 months does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in the past two months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator for economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 5% in 2 months does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in more than 55% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the past two months signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases > 1% in 2 months does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% in the past three months signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% in 3 months does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in the past month, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: If the combined conditions of UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month do not lead to positive 5-day forward returns in more than 70% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% in the past two months signals strong consumer demand, which is a leading indicator for economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases > 1% in 2 months does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in more than 55% of the observed periods.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.3% in the past month, it signals inflationary pressure coupled with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.3% in 1 month
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with inflationary pressure
failure_condition: If the combined conditions of FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.3% in 1 month do not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances.
